visual_action: A black and white video shows Donald Trump walking on a stage in front of a crowd. It then cuts to a rapid montage of color images: an In-N-Out Burger restaurant, a stick of Dove Men+Care deodorant, a glass of iced coffee, a machine (autopen) signing "Joe Biden" on a document, a man installing an air conditioner, a NASCAR race, and a Costco store.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown in black and white at the beginning of the video walking on a stage.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: His signature, "Joe Biden", is shown being written by an autopen machine in the montage.

cast.name: In-N-Out Burger
cast.evidence: A shot of an In-N-Out Burger sign is included in the montage.

cast.name: Dove Men+Care
cast.evidence: A stick of Dove Men+Care deodorant is shown in the montage.

cast.name: NASCAR
cast.evidence: Footage of a stock car race, characteristic of NASCAR, is included in the montage.

cast.name: Costco Wholesale
cast.evidence: A shot of the exterior of a Costco Wholesale store is included in the montage.

on_screen_text.text: And they say America has no culture...

spoken_summary: The audio begins with crowd noise and a distorted voice saying a phrase like "have you seen this shit?". This is immediately followed by a loud, energetic, bass-boosted hip-hop song that plays over the montage.
audio_music: The video opens with indistinct crowd sounds. A distorted voice clip serves as a lead-in to a very loud, bass-heavy, fast-paced hip-hop track that scores the entire montage. The effect is aggressive and energetic, intended to function as a 'hype' track.
editing_pacing: The video begins with slow-motion shots of Donald Trump, then transitions into a rapid-fire montage of still images, creating a fast and energetic pace.
cultural_references: Uses the 'And they say [X] has no culture...' meme format, where a statement is rebutted with a montage of examples.
central_claim: America possesses a strong and authentic culture, exemplified by popular consumer brands, motorsports, and conveniences, in contrast to political opponents who are presented as inauthentic.
intended_effect: To instill a sense of nationalistic pride in a particular vision of American culture while simultaneously mocking both external critics and domestic political opponents.
